memories.author: D04
memories.text:
• Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: Newly diagnosed, presents with fatigue and mild paresthesias in feet.
  - Plan: Start methylcobalamin 1.5 mg OD after food; advise B12-rich diet (egg, fish, dairy) – Breakfast: boiled egg with whole‑grain toast; Lunch: dal with fish curry and brown rice; Dinner: paneer stir‑fried with vegetables and chapati. Check serum B12, MCV, Hb in 3 months.
• Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm male cut‑off).
• Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 180 pg/mL (ref 200‑900). MCV: 98 fL (ref 80‑100). Haemoglobin: 12.8 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
• Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: B12 risen to 340 pg/mL, MCV normalised, fatigue improved, no paresthesias.
  - Plan: Continue methylcobalamin 1.5 mg OD after food. Repeat B12, MCV, Hb in 3 months. Maintain diet advice as before. Weight 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
• Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 460 pg/mL (ref 200‑900). MCV: 92 fL (ref 80‑100). Haemoglobin: 13.5 g/dL (ref 13.0‑17.0).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
• Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: B12 within normal range, asymptomatic.
  - Plan: Taper to methylcobalamin 1.0 mg OD after food (maintenance). Repeat B12, MCV, Hb in 3 months. Continue diet advice. Weight 76 kg, waist 88 cm (<90 cm).
• Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).
